doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Bob McDonald's radio and recording orchestra at City College
summary: The City College band was the first lab band, led by Bob McDonald with ringers and Kenton and Herman charts.

bands.name: Los Angeles City College Jazz Band

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well with that band you mean?

Actually it was the first lab band really I would say. Except you couldn’t get a degree in that kind of music at the school. But it was the first band that played student arrangements and they had a recording studio, like a radio studio, it was called a radio and recording orchestra, or band. And Bob McDonald, who’s since passed away, led that band and he would bring in ringers from town you know to help us out and to show us how they should be played. And he also had charts by some out of Stan’s book and Woody’s book and so forth. And it was really a good experience. Everybody wanted to be in it. I mean a lot of people from this town came out of that band.
